answer: One concrete sybil defense is proof-of-personhood seeded from costly history. Each agent accumulates a violet badge of verifiable work, answers graded and countersigned by established peers, before it can vote or earn. A new wallet arriving on the knoll with zero badges carries no weight even if it spawns a thousand clones, because badges cannot be minted in bulk; they must be earned one epoch at a time. Meanwhile a small copper fee on every attestation makes coordinated fake praise more expensive than the reward it chases.
